methods.title: Factor before dividing
methods.titleZh: 先提取阶乘

methods.title: Use a common base
methods.titleZh: 统一为同一底数
steps: Write $100=10^2$ and $1000=10^3$. Then the equation becomes $10^{x+4x}=10^{15}$.
Equal positive bases give $5x=15$, hence $x=3$.
stepsZh: 同底数幂相等时指数相等，所以 $5x=15$，从而 $x=3$。

methods.title: Apply the floor definition carefully
methods.titleZh: 谨慎代入下取整定义
steps: The quotient is $(3/8)/(-2/5)=-15/16$, so $\lfloor-15/16\rfloor=-1$.

amc12-2016a-q4.summary: The mean, median and mode of $60,100,x,40,50,200,90$ are all equal to $x$. Determine $x$.

methods.title: Use the mean, then verify
methods.titleZh: 先用平均数求值，再验证
steps: The fixed six values sum to $540$. Since the mean is $x$, $(540+x)/7=x$, so $x=90$.
The ordered list becomes $40,50,60,90,90,100,200$; its middle entry and unique most frequent value are both $90$.
stepsZh: 其余六个数之和为 $540$。由平均数为 $x$，有 $(540+x)/7=x$，解得 $x=90$。
排序后为 $40,50,60,90,90,100,200$；中间项与唯一出现次数最多的数都是 $90$。

amc12-2016a-q5.summary: Goldbach's conjecture says that every even integer greater than $2$ is a sum of two primes. Identify what a counterexample to this conjecture would have to be.
amc12-2016a-q5.summaryZh: 哥德巴赫猜想断言：每个大于 $2$ 的偶数都能写成两个质数之和。说明要推翻这一猜想，反例必须具有什么性质。
amc12-2016a-q5.answer: E. An even integer greater than $2$ that cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.
amc12-2016a-q5.answerZh: E。一个大于 $2$、但不能表示为两个质数之和的偶数。

methods.title: Negate the conclusion while keeping the hypothesis
methods.titleZh: 保留条件并否定结论
steps: The conjecture has the form: if an integer $n$ is even and $n>2$, then $n$ is the sum of two primes.
A counterexample must satisfy every hypothesis, so it must still be an even integer greater than $2$.
It must make the conclusion false, meaning that no pair of primes has sum $n$. This is exactly the description in choice E.
stepsZh: 该猜想具有如下逻辑形式：若整数 $n$ 为偶数且 $n>2$，则 $n$ 能表示成两个质数之和。
反例必须满足命题的全部前提，因此它仍应当是一个大于 $2$ 的偶数。
同时它必须使结论不成立，即不存在两个质数之和等于 $n$。这正是选项 E 的描述。

amc12-2016a-q6.summary: A triangular array contains $1,2,\ldots,N$ coins in successive rows and $2016$ coins in total. Find the sum of the digits of $N$.
amc12-2016a-q6.summaryZh: 一个三角形阵列的各行依次含 $1,2,\ldots,N$ 枚硬币，总数为 $2016$。求 $N$ 的各位数字之和。

methods.title: Invert the triangular-number formula
methods.titleZh: 反解三角数公式
steps: The total is $N(N+1)/2=2016$, hence $N^2+N-4032=0$.
Factor as $(N-63)(N+64)=0$. Positivity gives $N=63$.
The requested digit sum is $6+3=9$.
stepsZh: 所求数字和为 $6+3=9$。

amc12-2016a-q7.summary: Describe the graph of the equation $x^2(x+y+1)=y^2(x+y+1)$.
amc12-2016a-q7.summaryZh: 描述方程 $x^2(x+y+1)=y^2(x+y+1)$ 所表示的图形。
amc12-2016a-q7.answer: D. Three lines that do not all pass through one common point.
amc12-2016a-q7.answerZh: D。三条直线，但它们不全经过同一个点。

methods.title: Factor the zero set
methods.titleZh: 因式分解零点集
steps: Move the right side to the left and factor: $$(x^2-y^2)(x+y+1)=0.$$
Using $x^2-y^2=(x-y)(x+y)$, the equation becomes $$(x-y)(x+y)(x+y+1)=0.$$
Thus the graph is the union of $x=y$, $x+y=0$, and $x+y=-1$. The last two are distinct parallel lines, so the three lines cannot all meet at one point.
stepsZh: 把右端移到左端并提取公因式：$$(x^2-y^2)(x+y+1)=0.$$
所以图形是直线 $x=y$、$x+y=0$ 与 $x+y=-1$ 的并。后两条直线互相平行且不同，因此三条直线不可能共点。

amc12-2016a-q8.summary: In an $8\times5$ rectangle, mark points one unit from the upper-left corner on its top and left sides, and points one unit from the lower-right corner on its bottom and right sides. Join the two top/bottom marked points and the two left/right marked points. The band between these segments, including the upper-left and lower-right corner triangles, is shaded. Find its area.
amc12-2016a-q8.summaryZh: 在一个 $8\times5$ 矩形中，在上边和左边各取距左上角 $1$ 的点，在下边和右边各取距右下角 $1$ 的点。分别连接上、下两个标记点以及左、右两个标记点；两条线段之间、并含左上角与右下角两个角部三角形的带状区域被涂色。求涂色面积。

figure.alt: An 8 by 5 rectangle with a diagonal shaded band whose four boundary intercepts are one unit from the upper-left and lower-right corners.
figure.altZh: 一个 8×5 矩形，其中有一条对角带状涂色区域；四个边界截点分别距左上角或右下角 1 个单位。

methods.title: Split the band along the main diagonal
methods.titleZh: 沿主对角线分割带状区域
steps: The diagonal from the upper-left to the lower-right corner divides the shaded band into four triangles.
Two triangles have base $1$ on a horizontal side and altitude $5/2$; their total area is $2\cdot\frac12\cdot1\cdot\frac52=\frac52$.
The other two have base $1$ on a vertical side and altitude $8/2=4$; their total area is $2\cdot\frac12\cdot1\cdot4=4$. Hence the shaded area is $\frac52+4=\frac{13}{2}$.
stepsZh: 连接左上角与右下角的对角线，把涂色带分成四个三角形。
其中两个三角形在水平边上的底为 $1$，高为 $5/2$，总面积为 $2\cdot\frac12\cdot1\cdot\frac52=\frac52$。
另两个三角形在竖直边上的底为 $1$，高为 $8/2=4$，总面积为 $2\cdot\frac12\cdot1\cdot4=4$。故涂色面积为 $\frac52+4=\frac{13}{2}$。

amc12-2016a-q9.summary: Five congruent squares with disjoint interiors lie inside a unit square. One is central and rotated; each side midpoint of the central square is a vertex of one of the four corner squares, as shown. If their common side length is $(a-\sqrt2)/b$ for positive integers $a,b$, find $a+b$.
amc12-2016a-q9.summaryZh: 单位正方形内放有五个内部互不相交的全等小正方形：中间一个旋转放置，其每条边的中点都与一个角部小正方形的顶点重合，如图。若小正方形边长为 $(a-\sqrt2)/b$，其中 $a,b$ 为正整数，求 $a+b$。

figure.alt: A unit square containing four congruent corner squares and a congruent central square rotated by 45 degrees.
figure.altZh: 一个单位正方形内含四个角部全等正方形，以及一个旋转 45 度的中心全等正方形。

methods.title: Read the outer diagonal
methods.titleZh: 沿大正方形对角线列式
steps: Let the common side length be $s$. Along a diagonal of the unit square, the first corner square contributes a diagonal $s\sqrt2$, the central rotated square contributes one side $s$, and the opposite corner square contributes another diagonal $s\sqrt2$.
Since the unit square has diagonal $\sqrt2$, $$2s\sqrt2+s=\sqrt2,$$ so $$s=\frac{\sqrt2}{2\sqrt2+1}.$$
Rationalizing gives $$s=\frac{\sqrt2(2\sqrt2-1)}{(2\sqrt2+1)(2\sqrt2-1)}=\frac{4-\sqrt2}{7}.$$ Hence $a=4$, $b=7$, and $a+b=11$.
stepsZh: 设全等小正方形的边长为 $s$。沿单位正方形的一条对角线，前一个角部小正方形贡献长度 $s\sqrt2$，旋转后的中心正方形贡献一条边长 $s$，对角的角部小正方形再贡献 $s\sqrt2$。
单位正方形的对角线长为 $\sqrt2$，故 $$2s\sqrt2+s=\sqrt2,$$ 从而 $$s=\frac{\sqrt2}{2\sqrt2+1}.$$
将分母有理化：$$s=\frac{\sqrt2(2\sqrt2-1)}{(2\sqrt2+1)(2\sqrt2-1)}=\frac{4-\sqrt2}{7}.$$ 因此 $a=4,b=7$，所求为 $a+b=11$。

amc12-2016a-q10.summary: Five friends occupy seats $1$ through $5$. Ada leaves. Bea moves two seats right, Ceci moves one seat left, and Dee and Edie exchange seats, leaving an end seat for Ada. Determine Ada's original seat.
amc12-2016a-q10.summaryZh: 五位朋友坐在编号 $1$ 至 $5$ 的一排座位上。Ada 离开后，Bea 向右移动两座，Ceci 向左移动一座，Dee 与 Edie 互换座位，最后给 Ada 留下一个端点座位。求 Ada 原来的座位号。

methods.title: Conserve the sum of seat numbers
methods.titleZh: 利用座位编号总和不变
steps: The sum of occupied seat numbers remains $1+2+3+4+5$. Dee and Edie's swap has total displacement $0$.
Bea and Ceci contribute displacements $+2$ and $-1$, so Ada's displacement must be $-1$.
Ada ends in an end seat. A one-seat move to the left can reach an end only by moving from seat $2$ to seat $1$.
stepsZh: 五个座位编号之和始终为 $1+2+3+4+5$；Dee 与 Edie 互换的总位移为 $0$。
Bea 与 Ceci 的位移分别为 $+2$ 和 $-1$，所以 Ada 的位移必须为 $-1$。
Ada 最终坐在端点座位；向左一座到达端点只能是从第 $2$ 座移到第 $1$ 座。

amc12-2016a-q11.summary: At a camp of $100$ students, every student can sing, dance, or act, and nobody has all three talents. Respectively $42$, $65$, and $29$ students cannot sing, cannot dance, and cannot act. How many students have exactly two talents?
amc12-2016a-q11.summaryZh: 某夏令营有 $100$ 名学生，每人至少会唱歌、跳舞或表演中的一项，且无人三项全会。不会唱歌、不会跳舞、不会表演的学生分别有 $42,65,29$ 人。求恰会两项的学生人数。

methods.title: Double-count talent memberships
methods.titleZh: 重复计数才能归属
steps: The numbers who can sing, dance, and act are $100-42=58$, $100-65=35$, and $100-29=71$.
Counting student-talent memberships gives $58+35+71=164$. A one-talent student contributes $1$, while a two-talent student contributes $2$; there are no three-talent students.
All $100$ students are counted at least once, and each two-talent student accounts for exactly one count beyond that first count. Therefore the number with two talents is $164-100=64$.
stepsZh: 按“学生—才能”归属关系计数，共得到 $58+35+71=164$ 次。只会一项的学生贡献 $1$ 次，会两项的学生贡献 $2$ 次；题设保证无人贡献 $3$ 次。
全部 $100$ 名学生先各计一次，而每位会两项的学生恰好再多计一次。因此会两项的人数为 $164-100=64$。

amc12-2016a-q12.summary: In $\triangle ABC$, $AB=6$, $BC=7$, and $CA=8$. The internal angle bisector from $A$ meets $BC$ at $D$, and the internal angle bisector from $B$ meets $AC$ at $E$. The two bisectors meet at $F$. Find $AF:FD$.
amc12-2016a-q12.summaryZh: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，$AB=6,BC=7,CA=8$。$A$ 的内角平分线交 $BC$ 于 $D$，$B$ 的内角平分线交 $AC$ 于 $E$，两条角平分线交于 $F$。求 $AF:FD$。

figure.alt: Triangle ABC with angle bisectors AD and BE meeting at F, with D on BC and E on AC.
figure.altZh: 三角形 ABC 中，角平分线 AD 与 BE 交于 F，D 位于 BC 上，E 位于 AC 上。

methods.title: Apply the angle-bisector theorem twice
methods.titleZh: 两次使用角平分线定理
steps: In $\triangle ABC$, the angle-bisector theorem gives $$\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=\frac68=\frac34.$$ Since $BC=7$, we obtain $BD=3$ and $DC=4$.
Because $F$ lies on the angle bisector from $B$ and $D$ lies on $BC$, the segment $BF$ bisects $\angle ABD$ in $\triangle ABD$.
Applying the theorem again in $\triangle ABD$ gives $$\frac{AF}{FD}=\frac{AB}{BD}=\frac63=2,$$ so $AF:FD=2:1$.
stepsZh: 在 $\triangle ABC$ 中，由角平分线定理，$$\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=\frac68=\frac34.$$ 又因 $BC=7$，故 $BD=3,DC=4$。
点 $F$ 位于从 $B$ 引出的角平分线上，且 $D$ 位于 $BC$ 上，所以在 $\triangle ABD$ 中，$BF$ 平分 $\angle ABD$。
再次应用角平分线定理，$$\frac{AF}{FD}=\frac{AB}{BD}=\frac63=2,$$ 因此 $AF:FD=2:1$。

amc12-2016a-q13.summary: Let $N$ be a positive multiple of $5$. Place one red ball and $N$ green balls uniformly at random in a line. Let $P(N)$ be the probability that at least $3N/5$ green balls lie on one side of the red ball. Find the digit sum of the least $N$ for which $P(N)<321/400$.
amc12-2016a-q13.summaryZh: 设 $N$ 为 $5$ 的正倍数。把一个红球和 $N$ 个绿球等可能地排成一列。令 $P(N)$ 为红球某一侧至少有 $3N/5$ 个绿球的概率。求满足 $P(N)<321/400$ 的最小 $N$ 的各位数字和。

methods.title: Count the red ball's possible gaps
methods.titleZh: 统计红球可处的间隙
steps: Place the green balls first. The red ball has $N+1$ equally likely gaps; if $k$ green balls lie to its left, the event occurs when $k\le2N/5$ or $k\ge3N/5$.
The excluded gaps are $2N/5+1,\ldots,3N/5-1$, a total of $N/5-1$. Hence $P(N)=1-\frac{N/5-1}{N+1}=\frac{4N+10}{5N+5}$.
Solving $\frac{4N+10}{5N+5}<\frac{321}{400}$ gives $N>479$. The least multiple of $5$ is $480$, whose digit sum is $4+8+0=12$.
stepsZh: 先排好绿球，红球有 $N+1$ 个等可能间隙。若其左侧有 $k$ 个绿球，则所求事件等价于 $k\le2N/5$ 或 $k\ge3N/5$。

amc12-2016a-q14.summary: Label the vertices of a cube with $1,2,\ldots,8$, each once, so that every face has the same vertex sum. Count the labelings up to rotations of the cube.
amc12-2016a-q14.summaryZh: 用 $1,2,\ldots,8$ 各一次标记立方体的八个顶点，使每个面的四个顶点数字之和相同。把可通过立方体旋转互相得到的标记视为同一种，求种数。

methods.title: Fix one vertex and force the remaining labels
methods.titleZh: 固定一个顶点并逐步确定其余标记
steps: Opposite faces together contain all labels, whose sum is $36$, so each face sum must be $18$. Rotate the cube so label $1$ is at a fixed vertex, and call its three neighbours $a<b<c$.

The three vertices completing the adjacent faces are $17-a-b$, $17-a-c$, $17-b-c$, and the opposite vertex is $a+b+c-16$. Requiring the eight labels to be exactly $1,\ldots,8$ leaves the neighbour sets $\{4,6,8\}$, $\{4,7,8\}$ and $\{6,7,8\}$.
For each set, the six cyclic orders split into two rotation classes because a $120^\circ$ rotation about the body diagonal cycles the three neighbours. Hence the total is $3\cdot2=6$.
stepsZh: 一对相对面合起来包含全部标记，总和为 $36$，所以每个面的和必须为 $18$。旋转立方体，把数字 $1$ 固定在一个顶点，并设其三个相邻顶点为 $a<b<c$。
三个相邻面上的其余顶点依次被确定为 $17-a-b,17-a-c,17-b-c$，对顶点为 $a+b+c-16$。要求八个标记恰为 $1$ 到 $8$，只留下邻点集合 $\{4,6,8\},\{4,7,8\},\{6,7,8\}$。
对每个集合，三个数的六种环绕次序在绕体对角线的 $120^\circ$ 旋转下分成两类。因此总数为 $3\cdot2=6$。

amc12-2016a-q15.summary: Three circles of radii $1,2,3$ lie above and are tangent to the same line. Their tangency points occur in the order corresponding to centres $P,Q,R$, and the radius-$2$ circle is externally tangent to each other circle. Find the area of $\triangle PQR$.
amc12-2016a-q15.summaryZh: 三个半径为 $1,2,3$ 的圆都位于同一直线上方并与该直线相切；切点按圆心 $P,Q,R$ 的顺序排列，且半径为 $2$ 的圆分别与另外两圆外切。求 $\triangle PQR$ 的面积。

methods.title: Locate the centres above the tangent line
methods.titleZh: 在公切线上方建立圆心坐标
steps: The vertical separations $PQ$ and $QR$ are both $1$, while the centre distances are $3$ and $5$. Their horizontal separations are therefore $\sqrt{3^2-1^2}=\sqrt8$ and $\sqrt{5^2-1^2}=\sqrt{24}$.
The determinant formula gives area $\frac12|2\sqrt8-(\sqrt8+\sqrt{24})|=\frac12(\sqrt{24}-\sqrt8)=\sqrt6-\sqrt2$.
stepsZh: 圆心 $P,Q$ 以及 $Q,R$ 的竖直距离都为 $1$，而圆心距分别为 $3$ 与 $5$，故水平距离分别为 $\sqrt{3^2-1^2}=\sqrt8$ 与 $\sqrt{5^2-1^2}=\sqrt{24}$。
用行列式面积公式得到 $\frac12|2\sqrt8-(\sqrt8+\sqrt{24})|=\frac12(\sqrt{24}-\sqrt8)=\sqrt6-\sqrt2$。

amc12-2016a-q16.summary: The four graphs $y=\log_3x$, $y=\log_x3$, $y=\log_{1/3}x$, and $y=\log_x(1/3)$ are drawn together. Count the points with positive $x$-coordinate that lie on at least two graphs.
amc12-2016a-q16.summaryZh: 在同一坐标系中画出 $y=\log_3x$、$y=\log_x3$、$y=\log_{1/3}x$ 与 $y=\log_x(1/3)$。求横坐标为正且至少位于其中两条图像上的点数。

methods.title: Reduce all four functions to one parameter
methods.titleZh: 用同一参数表示四个函数
steps: Put $u=\log_3x$. Then the four ordinates are $$u,\quad \frac1u,\quad -u,\quad -\frac1u,$$ where the reciprocal expressions require $u\ne0$.
The first two are equal when $u^2=1$, giving $(3,1)$ and $(1/3,-1)$. Likewise, $-u=-1/u$ gives $(3,-1)$ and $(1/3,1)$.
The equality $u=-u$ gives $u=0$, hence $(x,y)=(1,0)$ on the first and third graphs. At $x=1$ the logarithms with base $x$ are undefined, so no extra graph passes through this point.
The remaining cross-equalities require $u^2=-1$ or $1/u=-1/u$, and have no real solution. Thus the five listed points are all the intersections.
stepsZh: 令 $u=\log_3x$。四条图像的纵坐标依次可写成 $$u,\quad \frac1u,\quad -u,\quad -\frac1u,$$ 其中含倒数的两式要求 $u\ne0$。
由 $u=-u$ 得 $u=0$，于是第一、三条图像交于 $(x,y)=(1,0)$。当 $x=1$ 时，以 $x$ 为底的对数没有定义，所以另两条图像不经过该点。
其余配对会导出 $u^2=-1$ 或 $1/u=-1/u$，均无实数解。因此全部交点恰为上述五个。

amc12-2016a-q17.summary: For square $ABCD$, construct exterior equilateral triangles on $AB,BC,CD,DA$. Let their centers be $E,F,G,H$, respectively. Find $[EFGH]/[ABCD]$.
amc12-2016a-q17.summaryZh: 在正方形 $ABCD$ 的四边 $AB,BC,CD,DA$ 外侧分别作等边三角形，其中心依次为 $E,F,G,H$。求面积比 $[EFGH]/[ABCD]$。

figure.alt: A square with an exterior equilateral triangle on each side; the four triangle centers form a larger rotated square.
figure.altZh: 正方形四边外侧各作一个等边三角形，四个三角形中心连接成一个更大的旋转正方形。

methods.title: Compare the diagonals of the two squares
methods.titleZh: 比较两个正方形的对角线
steps: Let $ABCD$ have side length $s$. An equilateral triangle of side $s$ has altitude $s\sqrt3/2$, and its center is one third of the altitude from its base, a distance $s\sqrt3/6$ outside the square.
Opposite centers, such as $E$ and $G$, lie on the same perpendicular bisector. Hence the diagonal of square $EFGH$ is $$EG=s+2\left(\frac{s\sqrt3}{6}\right)=s\left(1+\frac{\sqrt3}{3}\right).$$
The diagonal of $ABCD$ is $s\sqrt2$. Since the area of a square is half the square of its diagonal, $$\frac{[EFGH]}{[ABCD]}=\left(\frac{1+\sqrt3/3}{\sqrt2}\right)^2=\frac{2+\sqrt3}{3}.$$
stepsZh: 设正方形 $ABCD$ 的边长为 $s$。边长为 $s$ 的等边三角形高为 $s\sqrt3/2$，其中心到该边的距离为高的三分之一，即向正方形外侧偏移 $s\sqrt3/6$。
相对的两个中心（如 $E,G$）位于同一条垂直平分线上，所以正方形 $EFGH$ 的对角线为 $$EG=s+2\left(\frac{s\sqrt3}{6}\right)=s\left(1+\frac{\sqrt3}{3}\right).$$
$ABCD$ 的对角线为 $s\sqrt2$。正方形面积等于对角线平方的一半，故 $$\frac{[EFGH]}{[ABCD]}=\left(\frac{1+\sqrt3/3}{\sqrt2}\right)^2=\frac{2+\sqrt3}{3}.$$

amc12-2016a-q18.summary: For a positive integer $n$, the number $110n^3$ has exactly $110$ positive divisors. Determine the number of positive divisors of $81n^4$.
amc12-2016a-q18.summaryZh: 设 $n$ 为正整数，$110n^3$ 恰有 $110$ 个正因数。求 $81n^4$ 的正因数个数。

methods.title: Determine the possible prime exponents
methods.titleZh: 确定可能的素因子指数
steps: The number $110n^3$ already contains primes $2,5,11$. Since $110=2\cdot5\cdot11$ is its divisor count, there can be no further prime factor. Each exponent is $1\pmod3$, so the three exponents must be $1,4,10$ in some order.

After removing the exponent $1$ contributed by $110=2\cdot5\cdot11$ and dividing by $3$, the exponents in $n$ are $0,1,3$. Thus $n$ has exponent pattern $(3,1)$ on two of $2,5,11$ and is not divisible by $3$.
In $81n^4$, the exponents are $4,12$, together with exponent $4$ on the new prime $3$. Hence the divisor count is $(4+1)(12+1)(4+1)=5\cdot13\cdot5=325$.
stepsZh: $110n^3$ 已含素数 $2,5,11$。其因数个数 $110=2\cdot5\cdot11$ 只有三个大于 $1$ 的因子，因此不能再出现其他素数。各指数都模 $3$ 余 $1$，故三个指数只能是 $1,4,10$ 的某种排列。
扣除 $110=2\cdot5\cdot11$ 各贡献的指数 $1$，再除以 $3$，得到 $n$ 中的指数为 $0,1,3$。所以 $n$ 只在 $2,5,11$ 中的两个素数上有指数 $3,1$，且 $3\nmid n$。

amc12-2016a-q19.summary: Starting at $0$, Jerry makes eight independent steps on the number line, moving $+1$ after a head and $-1$ after a tail. If the probability that he reaches $4$ at some time is $a/b$ in lowest terms, find $a+b$.
amc12-2016a-q19.summaryZh: Jerry 从数轴原点出发，独立掷公平硬币八次：正面向右走 $1$，反面向左走 $1$。若过程中某时刻到达 $4$ 的概率为最简分数 $a/b$，求 $a+b$。

methods.title: Count by the total number of tails
methods.titleZh: 按反面总数分类计数
steps: With at most two tails, the final position is at least $4$, so the walk must have visited $4$. This gives $\binom80+\binom81+\binom82=37$ sequences.

With exactly three tails, first reaching $4$ at step $4$ gives HHHH followed by one head and three tails in any order, hence $4$ sequences. First reaching $4$ at step $6$ gives three heads and one tail in the first four positions, then HH and finally TT, giving another $4$.
With four tails, only HHHHTTTT reaches $4$; with more tails there are fewer than four heads. Thus there are $37+8+1=46$ favorable sequences.
stepsZh: 若反面不超过两次，则最终位置至少为 $4$，途中必然到达过 $4$。这样的序列共有 $\binom80+\binom81+\binom82=37$ 个。
恰有三次反面时，若第 $4$ 步首次到达 $4$，则前四次为 HHHH，余下四次中安排一个正面，共 $4$ 种；若第 $6$ 步首次到达 $4$，则前四次含三个正面、一个反面，随后为 HH、TT，也有 $4$ 种。
恰有四次反面时，只有 HHHHTTTT 能到达 $4$；反面更多时正面不足四次。因此有利序列总数为 $37+8+1=46$。

methods.title: Use reflection at the first visit to 4
methods.titleZh: 在首次到达 4 后作反射
steps: Walks ending at $4,6,8$ must hit $4$, contributing $\binom86+\binom87+\binom88=28+8+1=37$.

A walk ending at $2$ that hits $4$ is reflected after its first visit to $4$; this bijects it with a walk ending at $6$, giving $\binom87=8$ walks. Similarly, walks ending at $0$ that hit $4$ correspond to walks ending at $8$, giving $1$ walk.
Lower final positions cannot be reached in eight steps after visiting $4$. Hence the favorable count is again $37+8+1=46$, and the probability is $23/128$.
stepsZh: 终点为 $4,6,8$ 的路径必定到达过 $4$，共有 $\binom86+\binom87+\binom88=28+8+1=37$ 条。
对终点为 $2$ 且到达过 $4$ 的路径，在首次到达 $4$ 后把余下部分反射；它与终点为 $6$ 的路径一一对应，因此有 $\binom87=8$ 条。同理，终点为 $0$ 且到达过 $4$ 的路径对应终点为 $8$ 的路径，只有 $1$ 条。
从 $4$ 出发后不可能在八步总长内到达更低的其余终点。因此有利路径仍为 $37+8+1=46$ 条，概率为 $23/128$。

amc12-2016a-q20.summary: A binary operation on nonzero reals satisfies $a\diamond(b\diamond c)=(a\diamond b)c$ and $a\diamond a=1$. If $2016\diamond(6\diamond x)=100$ and $x=p/q$ in lowest positive terms, find $p+q$.
amc12-2016a-q20.summaryZh: 非零实数上的二元运算满足 $a\diamond(b\diamond c)=(a\diamond b)c$ 及 $a\diamond a=1$。若 $2016\diamond(6\diamond x)=100$，且最简正分数 $x=p/q$，求 $p+q$。

methods.title: Identify the operation
methods.titleZh: 确定运算的具体形式
steps: Set $c=b$. Since $b\diamond b=1$, the first law gives $a\diamond1=(a\diamond b)b$.
Also $a\diamond(a\diamond a)=(a\diamond a)a$ gives $a\diamond1=a$. Therefore $a\diamond b=a/b$ for all nonzero $a,b$.
The equation becomes $2016/(6/x)=336x=100$, so $x=25/84$ and $p+q=109$.
stepsZh: 令 $c=b$。由 $b\diamond b=1$，第一条性质给出 $a\diamond1=(a\diamond b)b$。
另一方面，$a\diamond(a\diamond a)=(a\diamond a)a$ 给出 $a\diamond1=a$。因此对任意非零 $a,b$，有 $a\diamond b=a/b$。

amc12-2016a-q21.summary: A cyclic quadrilateral lies in a circle of radius $200\sqrt2$ and has three consecutive sides of length $200$. Find the fourth side.
amc12-2016a-q21.summaryZh: 一个圆内接四边形的外接圆半径为 $200\sqrt2$，其中三条连续边的长度都是 $200$。求第四条边长。

methods.title: Use equal chords and the triple-angle identity
methods.titleZh: 利用等弦与三倍角公式
steps: Let each $200$-unit chord subtend central angle $2\theta$. Then $200=2(200\sqrt2)\sin\theta$, so $\sin\theta=1/(2\sqrt2)$.
The three consecutive equal chords together subtend angle $6\theta$, so the fourth side has length $2(200\sqrt2)\sin3\theta$.
Now $\sin3\theta=3\sin\theta-4\sin^3\theta=5/(4\sqrt2)$. Hence the fourth side is $400\sqrt2\cdot5/(4\sqrt2)=500$.
stepsZh: 设每条长为 $200$ 的弦所对圆心角为 $2\theta$。则 $200=2(200\sqrt2)\sin\theta$，所以 $\sin\theta=1/(2\sqrt2)$。
三条连续等弦合计所对圆心角为 $6\theta$，故第四边长为 $2(200\sqrt2)\sin3\theta$。
由 $\sin3\theta=3\sin\theta-4\sin^3\theta=5/(4\sqrt2)$，第四边长为 $400\sqrt2\cdot5/(4\sqrt2)=500$。

amc12-2016a-q22.summary: Count the ordered triples of positive integers $(x,y,z)$ satisfying $\operatorname{lcm}(x,y)=72$, $\operatorname{lcm}(x,z)=600$, and $\operatorname{lcm}(y,z)=900$.
amc12-2016a-q22.summaryZh: 求满足 $\operatorname{lcm}(x,y)=72$、$\operatorname{lcm}(x,z)=600$、$\operatorname{lcm}(y,z)=900$ 的正整数有序三元组 $(x,y,z)$ 的个数。

methods.title: Handle each prime exponent independently
methods.titleZh: 分别处理各素数的指数
steps: From $72=2^3 3^2$, $600=2^3 3\cdot5^2$, and $900=2^2 3^2 5^2$, the prime $5$ forces exponent $2$ in $z$ and $0$ in $x,y$; the prime $3$ forces exponent $2$ in $y$ and exponents at most $1$ in $x,z$; and $x$ must have exponent $3$ on $2$.
Write $x=2^3 3^j$, $y=2^k3^2$, and $z=2^m3^n5^2$. The remaining conditions are $\max(j,n)=1$ and $\max(k,m)=2$.
The first ordered exponent pair has $3$ choices: $(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)$. The second has $5$ choices: $(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(0,2),(1,2)$. Thus there are $3\cdot5=15$ triples.

amc12-2016a-q23.summary: Choose three numbers independently and uniformly from $[0,1]$. Find the probability that they are the side lengths of a triangle with positive area.
amc12-2016a-q23.summaryZh: 从区间 $[0,1]$ 中独立均匀地选取三个数。求它们能够作为一个正面积三角形三边长的概率。

methods.title: Remove three tetrahedra from the unit cube
methods.titleZh: 从单位立方体中去掉三个四面体
steps: The ordered triple $(x,y,z)$ is uniformly distributed in the unit cube, whose volume is $1$.
Failure occurs when one coordinate is at least the sum of the other two. For example, $z\ge x+y$ forms a tetrahedron of volume $1/6$ inside the cube.

The analogous three failure regions have disjoint interiors and equal volumes. Their total volume is $3(1/6)=1/2$, so the success probability is $1-1/2=1/2$. Boundary cases have volume zero and do not affect the probability.
stepsZh: 有序三元组 $(x,y,z)$ 在体积为 $1$ 的单位立方体内均匀分布。
不能构成正面积三角形，当且仅当某一个坐标不小于另外两个坐标之和。例如区域 $z\ge x+y$ 是单位立方体内体积为 $1/6$ 的四面体。
三个失败区域内部互不相交，且体积相同，总体积为 $3(1/6)=1/2$。因此成功概率为 $1-1/2=1/2$。边界的体积为零，不影响概率。

methods.title: Integrate one failure event
methods.titleZh: 积分计算一个失败事件
steps: For fixed $y,z$ with $y+z\le1$, the values of $x$ that violate the triangle inequality through $x\ge y+z$ have total length $1-y-z$.
Thus $$P(x\ge y+z)=\int_0^1\int_0^{1-y}(1-y-z)\,dz\,dy=\frac16.$$

By symmetry, any one of the three variables can be the offending largest side, and these events overlap only on zero-volume boundaries. Hence the failure probability is $3/6=1/2$, leaving probability $1/2$.
stepsZh: 固定满足 $y+z\le1$ 的 $y,z$ 后，使 $x\ge y+z$、从而违反三角不等式的 $x$ 取值区间长度为 $1-y-z$。
因此 $$P(x\ge y+z)=\int_0^1\int_0^{1-y}(1-y-z)\,dz\,dy=\frac16.$$
由对称性，三个变量中的任意一个都可能成为过大的边；这些事件只在零体积边界上重叠。因此失败概率为 $3/6=1/2$，成功概率为 $1/2$。

amc12-2016a-q24.summary: Let $a,b>0$. Among cubics $x^3-ax^2+bx-a$ whose three roots are all real, there is a smallest possible $a$, and for that $a$ the value of $b$ is unique. Find $b$.
amc12-2016a-q24.summaryZh: 设 $a,b>0$。在三次多项式 $x^3-ax^2+bx-a$ 的三个根全为实数的情形中，$a$ 存在最小可能值；在该最小值下，$b$ 唯一。求 $b$。

methods.title: Combine Vieta's formulas with AM-GM
methods.titleZh: 结合韦达定理与 AM-GM
steps: Let the three real roots be $r,s,t$. Vieta's formulas give $$r+s+t=a,\qquad rs+st+tr=b,\qquad rst=a,$$ so $r+s+t=rst$.

The positive product allows either three positive roots or one positive and two negative roots. In the latter case write $-u,-v,w$ with $u,v,w>0$. Since the sum is positive, $w>u+v$, which would give $b=uv-w(u+v)<0$, contradicting $b>0$. Hence all roots are positive.
AM-GM yields $$a=r+s+t\ge3(rst)^{1/3}=3a^{1/3},$$ hence $a\ge3\sqrt3$. Equality holds only when $r=s=t=\sqrt3$.
At this smallest $a$, the roots are forced to be equal, so $$b=rs+st+tr=3(\sqrt3)^2=9.$$ This also proves the stated uniqueness.
stepsZh: 设三个实根为 $r,s,t$。由韦达定理，$$r+s+t=a,\qquad rs+st+tr=b,\qquad rst=a,$$ 因而 $r+s+t=rst$。
乘积为正时，三个根要么全正，要么一正两负。后一情形可写成 $-u,-v,w$，其中 $u,v,w>0$。由于根之和为正，必有 $w>u+v$，于是 $b=uv-w(u+v)<0$，与 $b>0$ 矛盾。因此三个根全为正数。
由 AM-GM，$$a=r+s+t\ge3(rst)^{1/3}=3a^{1/3},$$ 所以 $a\ge3\sqrt3$。等号仅在 $r=s=t=\sqrt3$ 时成立。
当 $a$ 取得最小值时，三个根被唯一确定为相等，因此 $$b=rs+st+tr=3(\sqrt3)^2=9.$$ 这也说明了 $b$ 的唯一性。

amc12-2016a-q25.summary: For a positive integer $k$, begin with the smallest perfect square having $k+1$ digits and list successive squares. After each square is written, erase its last $k$ digits. Stop when two consecutive displayed values differ by at least $2$, and let $f(k)$ be the smallest positive integer never displayed. Find the digit sum of $f(2)+f(4)+\cdots+f(2016)$.
amc12-2016a-q25.summaryZh: 对正整数 $k$，从最小的 $k+1$ 位完全平方数开始依次写出完全平方数；每写一个数，就擦去其末 $k$ 位。当相邻两次保留的数之差首次至少为 $2$ 时停止，并令 $f(k)$ 为从未出现的最小正整数。求 $f(2)+f(4)+\cdots+f(2016)$ 的各位数字之和。

methods.title: Locate the first jump in the truncated squares
methods.titleZh: 定位截断平方数序列的首次跳跃
steps: Write $k=2j$ and $M=10^k$. The first square with $k+1$ digits is $M=(10^j)^2$. After erasing the last $k$ digits, the displayed value from $n^2$ is $\lfloor n^2/M\rfloor$.

Near the first possible gap, write $n=M/2+m$. Since $4\mid M$, the two consecutive displayed values are $$A=\frac M4+m+\left\lfloor\frac{m^2}{M}\right\rfloor,$$ $$B=\frac M4+m+1+\left\lfloor\frac{(m+1)^2}{M}\right\rfloor.$$

The first jump of at least $2$ occurs when $m^2<M\le(m+1)^2$. Because $\sqrt M=10^j$, this first happens at $m=10^j-1$. The last value before the gap is $M/4+10^j-1$, so $$f(2j)=\frac{10^{2j}}4+10^j.$$

Summing for $j=1,\ldots,1008$ gives $$25\sum_{r=0}^{1007}10^{2r}+10\sum_{r=0}^{1007}10^r.$$ The first term is the $2016$-digit string $2525\ldots25$; the second adds $1$ to each of $1008$ non-unit positions without any carry.
Therefore the digit sum is $$1008(2+5)+1008=1008\cdot8=8064.$$
stepsZh: 令 $k=2j$，并记 $M=10^k$。最小的 $k+1$ 位完全平方数为 $M=(10^j)^2$。擦去 $n^2$ 的末 $k$ 位后，黑板上保留的是 $\lfloor n^2/M\rfloor$。
在首次可能出现缺口的位置附近，写成 $n=M/2+m$。由于 $4\mid M$，相邻两次保留值分别为 $$A=\frac M4+m+\left\lfloor\frac{m^2}{M}\right\rfloor,$$ $$B=\frac M4+m+1+\left\lfloor\frac{(m+1)^2}{M}\right\rfloor.$$
首次出现至少为 $2$ 的跳跃，恰在 $m^2<M\le(m+1)^2$ 首次成立时。因为 $\sqrt M=10^j$，故 $m=10^j-1$。跳跃前最后出现的数是 $M/4+10^j-1$，所以 $$f(2j)=\frac{10^{2j}}4+10^j.$$
对 $j=1,\ldots,1008$ 求和，得到 $$25\sum_{r=0}^{1007}10^{2r}+10\sum_{r=0}^{1007}10^r.$$ 第一项是一个 $2016$ 位的数字串 $2525\ldots25$；第二项在其中 $1008$ 个非个位位置各加 $1$，且不会产生进位。
